values.note: 'Call the Campground to make Reservations 906-428-1211' (camp@gladstonemi.org). The button on the city page opens the city's Rec1 catalog, which sells facility rentals, boat-launch permits and programs but lists no campsites.

booking.source: https://www.gladstonemi.gov/parks-and-recreation/page/gladstone-bay-campground ('Call the Campground to make Reservations 906-428-1211') + https://secure.rec1.com/MI/city-of-gladstone-mi/catalog (tabs: Downtown Market Square, Facility Rentals, Boat Launch Permits, Sail School, Gladstone Ski Hill, Gladstone Farmer's Market; no campground), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Gladstone campground at 37 Michigan Ave on Little Bay de Noc (Lake Michigan), with a 1,500-ft sandy beach and deck, a boardwalk and bike path, and a playground. Full-hookup, water-and-electric, electric-only and tent sites, with a mix of transient and seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: City page (read in a browser; curl gets 403) confirms the $20 tent / $30 electric / $35 water-electric / $40 full daily rates (stored; weekly and monthly rates too, no year and no resident/non-resident split), water/sewer, dump, wifi, showers. Booking changed operator -> phone: reservations are by calling the campground, and the Rec1 link sells no campsites. Not stated by the city: amperage, site count, max rig length, season (stored 50-amp, 65 sites and 60 ft left as derived from the note). Note: amenity, booking and site-count text dropped; 'online through the city' was wrong.
flags: Website: the Rec1 link is a long filter URL into the city's Rec1 catalog, which lists no campsites (only facility rentals, boat-launch permits, programs); there is no online campground booking, so there is no stable booking link to give. Reservations are by phone, 906-428-1211. Suggest dropping the Rec1 link and keeping https://www.gladstonemi.gov/parks-and-recreation/page/gladstone-bay-campground.
